profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer at Northrop Grumman
profile.summary:
I developed a passion for engineering early on due to my father, who is a civil engineer for Caltrans. My father encouraged me to take my interest of math and science into a career where I could apply it critically and solve peoples' problems. I chose to pursue Electrical and Computer Engineering as I enjoy circuit design and programming.

Thus far my schooling has provided me the opportunity to grow my knowledge in circuit theory and in programming languages such as C++, Verilog, and LabView. But my schooling has done more than given me knowledge. I have given several presentations on my completed projects and my freshman team of 3 people, including myself, won first in our freshman design contest. Opportunities such as these have allowed me to mature in real life skills including communication, multi-tasking, and teamwork. 

I have gained valuable skills from my jobs during college as well. I have been a student worker at the Conferences and Events Department for California Baptist University for over 2 years. During that time I have progressed in my ability to manage both tasks and people as I am often the lead worker on my shifts. I am also a tutor at California Baptist University for Circuit Theory I. This position has given me the chance to learn how to present technical ideas, in various ways, to a group. As a result I not only help those I am tutoring but I myself gain a better grasp of the concepts.

At this point I have been able to learn how the concepts of engineering can be applied in our everyday lives to meet peoples' needs with my position as an Electrical engineer with NSWC Corona and I look forward to expanding that knowledge with my position as an Embedded Software Engineer with Northrop Grumman.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: I was approached by the Head of the Electrical and Computer Engineer and offered the position to be a Teaching Assistant. I grade homework assignments, lab reports, and projects for several technical courses.

positions.title: Event Staff
positions.description: Set up and tore down events happening all across the California Baptist University campus. I have utilized and am proficient with audio visual equipment such as soundboards, microphones, and speakers. Directed teams of up to 10 people in order fulfill all necessary tasks.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: Tutored Circuit Theory for both freshman and sophomore students and communicated technical concepts in a variety of ways in an attempt to help students learn.

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Intern
positions.description: During the summer of 2019 I was an Electrical Engineering Intern for Navsea Warfare Centers in Corona, California. During my time there I utilized Python in order to automate mundane and repetitive data sorting tasks and researched how this data could be used in machine learning to help analysts more quickly understand issues. I also obtained a confidential security clearance.
